newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ergo cuts fixed 3-yr NZ mortgage rate to 8.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ergo cuts fixed 3-yr NZ mortgage rate to 8.9 pct.

text.p: AMP telephone banking unit Ergo said on Friday it was cutting its three-year fixed home loan interest rate to 8.9 percent from 9.5 percent.
The one and two-year fixed rates remain unchanged at 9.65 percent and 9.50 percent, while the floating rate is 10.4 percent.

"No matter what happens during the coming year, interest rates are unlikely to fall too much further below nine percent," said Managing Director Graham Meyer. "We are offering people the security of a fixed rate which is unlikely to be beaten for some time." -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
